title: antiaris toxicaria subsp. macrophylla
intro: Antiaris toxicaria subsp. macrophylla, commonly known as the giant leopard tree or giant Antiaris, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Antiaris toxicaria subsp. macrophylla include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria and fungi, and protect against oxidative stress, making it a valuable treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
